verdict.rationale: ROS 2 has its own machine-readable interface definitions: message files (ros2-comm-6), shared message definitions packages interoperate on (ros2-comm-19), and code generators every client library implements (ros2-docs-59). That is an IDL-style equivalent for communication interfaces, but the evidence never documents a downloadable, consolidated spec of ROS 2's own APIs. missing for 10: a documented downloadable machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent) covering the client-library/CLI APIs, first-party docs describing the interface definition format as a spec artifact, independent corroboration of AI/agent use of such specs
